programme.title: Mērdoka noslēpumi
programme.desc: Savās mājās tiek nogalināti četri cilvēki, kurus it kā nekas nesasista, ja neskaita to, ka iepriekš viņi atradušies uz viena ielas stūra. Tā kā visi nošauti ar vienu ieroci, Mērdokam rodas aizdomas, ka jāmeklē sērijveida slepkava. Lai atklātu šo noziegumu, Krebtrijam pat nākas kļūt par slepkavas nākamo mērķi.

programme.title: Eiropa fokusā
programme.desc: "Deutsche Welle" žurnāls stāsta par cilvēku dzīvi Eiropā, viņu cerībām un bailēm, sniedz plašu pārskatu pār tautu, kultūru un ainavu daudzveidību tajā.

programme.title: Rīta Panorāma
programme.desc: Enerģisks un iedvesmojošs sākums jaunai dienai! Ieskats gaidāmās dienas notikumos Latvijā un pasaulē, kultūras, izklaides un sporta ziņas, laika prognoze. Arī atskats uz aizvadītās dienas notikumiem, pievēršot uzmanību to attīstībai nakts laikā. Aizrautīgas sarunas ar viesiem un skanīgi muzikālie priekšnesumi. Raidījumu vada Gusts Kikusts, Sigurds Siliņš, Karīna Rubene, Danuta Juste, sporta ziņas lasa Reinis Ošenieks, Raimonds Gekišs, laika ziņas – Ilze Skudra, Ilze Golubeva, Toms Bricis.

programme.title: Kultūršoks
programme.desc: Kultūra ir ne vien māksla, bet arī nauda, projekti, ražošana un gan radoši, gan postoši konflikti. Par kultūrvides problēmām un šokējošām atklāsmēm — raidījums "Kultūršoks".

programme.title: Province
programme.desc: Atašienē Anna Mestere ir ienācēja. Tāpēc tas nebija nekāds brīnums, ka vietējie kaimiņi tādai svešiniecei savas ogu vietas atklāt negribēja. Bet ogas Annai lasīt vajadzēja, jo ar Stirnienes stacijas medpunkta feldšeres un vēlāk stacijas dežurantes niecīgo aldziņu viena pati bērnus pabarot nevarēja. Tā viņa jau pirms gadiem četrdesmit pa apkārtnes purviem sāka ogot, savulaik gadā salasot pat līdz tonnai dzērveņu, ar dzelzceļa darbinieka brīvbiļeti vest smagos ogu grozus uz Rīgas Centrāltirgu, un ļaudis viņu iesauca par Ogu Anniņu. Par ogu naudu ir gan govs nopirkta, gan mājas celtniecībai piepalīdzēts. Dzērvenes tiek lasītas joprojām, piedevām, cienot purvu, tikai un vienīgi ar rokām. Tāpat, lai saglabātu izzūdošās vietējās katoļu tradīcijas, Anna ar dažiem domubiedriem turpina psalmu jeb saļmu dziedāšanu, aizgājējam pēdējo godu izrādot.

programme.title: Dzīve savvaļā kopā ar Benu Fouglu
programme.desc: Britu dēkainis Bens Fougls šajā dokumentālo filmu ciklā dodas ceļā, lai iepazītos ar cilvēkiem, kas pagriezuši muguru drudžainajam dzīves ritmam un sabiedrībai un nolēmuši vadīt noslēgtu dzīvi neparastās vietās savvaļā saskaņā ar dabu un bez komunālajiem pakalpojumiem. Ceļojums Benu aizvedīs gan uz dažādām interesantām vietām Lielbritānijā, gan uz Islandi. Bens vienu nedēļu mēģinās iejusties viņu dzīvē un piedalīties viņu nodarbēs, katru reizi atklājot un iemācoties kaut ko jaunu.

programme.title: Filmas arheoloģija
programme.desc: Filma, kurā Jānis Streičs kļuva par Jāni Streiču! Kino vēsture: tās varoņi un ne-varoņi leģendārajā filmā "Mans draugs – nenopietns cilvēks" (1975). Kā greizo spoguļu PSRS valstībā izdzīvoja Arvīds Lasmanis? Stāsts par pagājušu laikmetu un dzīvesveidu, jo Arvīds Lasmanis bija uz visu savu darba vietu goda plāksnēm un vienmēr pameta haltūristus uz paša vēlēšanos. Ideālists ar zelta rokām, taisnu mugurkaulu un sapni par daudzbērnu ģimeni. Viņš bija gatavs strādāt uz pilnu jaudu, bet bija piedzimis Padomju Savienībā. Tos sauca par Brežņeva laikiem, un Ēvalda Valtera kuplās uzacis varēja izraisīt nepareizas asociācijas, kuru dēļ filmu varēja aizklapēt ciet. Tolaik kaprači bija naudīga profesija, bet jaunam ideālistam nācās cīnīties ne tikai par iztikšanu komunālajā dzīvoklī, bet arī par cieņu darbavietā. Dzīvespriecīga jauna cilvēka, kuru sauca Arvīds, tā laika kinomākslai ļoti pietrūka… Jānis Streičs zināja, par ko var un vajag jokot uz ekrāna Padomju Savienībā. Filma "Mans draugs – nenopietns cilvēks" Jāni Streiču padarīja par kino meistaru, jo viņš spēja uztaisīt filmu, kurā katrs kino skatītājs, tā vai citādi, spēja ieraudzīt gan dramatiskas, gan komiskas references par savu dzīvi. Ciklā "Filmas arheoloģija" atgriezīsimies nozieguma vietā – Rīgas kinostudijā kopā ar mūžam smaidīgo Jāni Paukštello, nopietno režisoru Jāni Streiču un viņa uzticamo asistenti Ilzi Līci. Mūsu varoņi: kostīmu māksliniece Skaidra Deksne, kino operators Miks Zvirbulis, publicists Ēriks Hānbergs un toreizējie filmas aktieri – Raimonds Auškāps, Kārlis Pumpuriņš, Jānis Liepiņš un Valdis Liepiņš. Jautājums ir atvērts: vai Arvīds Lasmanis bija radinieks Raiņa Antiņam, latviešu pasaku trešajam tēva dēlam vai tomēr paša Jāņa Streiča slēptajam "alter ego"? "Filmas arheoloģija. Mans draugs – nenopietns cilvēks" ir laikmeta pētījums, nezaudējot jautrību.

programme.title: Revidents
programme.desc: Latvijas Televīzijas kanālā atgriežas izzinošs raidījums "Revidents"! Arī šajā sezonā Ieva Strazdiņa kopā ar raidījuma komandu katru nedēļu skaidros, kā labāk, ērtāk un vieglāk tikt galā ar dažādiem ikdienā aktuāliem jautājumiem un izaicinājumiem. Intervijas ar attiecīgo nozaru ekspertiem papildinās dažādi radoši eksperimenti, sabiedrības viedokļa noskaidrošana, kā arī līdz šim zināmo un izskanējušo faktu analīze.

programme.title: Mērdoka noslēpumi
programme.desc: Notiek pārdroša bankas pajūga aplaupīšana, kuras laikā viens no zagļiem nogalina otru. Mērdoks sastopas ar neparastu liecinieku – cilvēku, kurš sevi dēvē par Šerloku Holmsu. Viņš ne tikai aktīvi iesaistās izmeklēšanā, bet arī ir pārliecināts, ka notikušo noziegumu noorganizējis Moriartijs.

programme.title: Mērdoka noslēpumi
programme.desc: Netālu no natūristu apmetnes, kas pieder Helmutam Lindemanam un viņa sievai Airīnai, tiek atrasts vīrieša līķis. Taču kopiena neuzticas cilvēkiem no malas un policijai, tāpēc Krebtrijam nākas tajā iefiltrēties. Lai Ogdena varētu šķirt laulību ar Dārsiju, nepieciešami pierādījumi, ka viņa viņam nav uzticīga.

programme.title: Alpu dakteris
programme.desc: Nav labākas vietas, kur patverties no pilsētas kņadas, trokšņa un stresa, kā kalni. Bet dzīvot tur? Dzimto Alpu mazpilsētiņu, saucot tās gaisotni par smacējošu un aprobežotu, Mārtins pameta jau pirms daudziem gadiem, lai kļūtu par veiksmīgu ārstu kosmopolītiskajā lielpilsētā Ņujorkā. Nu viņš ir atgriezies. Uz pavisam īsu apciemojumu, lai atkal drīz atvadītos. Taču no likteņa neizbēgsi - atgriešanās mājās izrādās uz palikšanu. Jo pārāk liels ir trieciens, uzzinot, ka viņa pirmā mīlestība, kas pēc Mārtina aizbraukšanas apprecēja viņa paša brāli Hansu, ir mirusi. Taču atstājusi meitu, par kuras esamību Mārtins nekad pat nebija zinājis! Ar to izrādās pietiekami, lai izlemtu palikt Pēkšņi kļuvis par tēvu, Mārtins vēlas uzzināt vairāk par savu jauniegūto meitu Lili, iemantot viņas uzticēšanos. Tā dēļ viņš ir gatavs pat mēģināt sadarboties ar savu jaunāko brāli Hansu, kas joprojām jūt aizvainojumu. Hanss ir kļuvis par glābēju komandas vadītāju, un kopā ar Mārtinu viņi turpmāk neskaitāmas reizes riskēs ar savu dzīvību, lai glābtu kalnu negadījumu upurus vai kāpējus, ko pārsteigusi pēkšņa vētra. Mārtinu gaida atklāsme, ka bez saknēm nav iespējas turpināt dzīvi. Šeit viņš pilnībā aptvers arī to, ka būt par ārstu kalnos - tā nav tikai profesija, bet gan aicinājums. Kļūt par labu neatliekamās medicīniskās palīdzības sniedzēju kalnos iemācīties nevar, par tādu piedzimst. Un Mārtins Grūbers tāds neapšaubāmi ir!

programme.title: FIBA Pasaules kauss basketbolā sievietēm. Itālija – ASV
programme.desc: Turnīra galvenās favorītes savas apakšgrupas otrās kārtas spēlē pret Itāliju. Ja amerikānietes ir izteiktas favorītes šajā grupā un visā turnīrā, tad pārējās komandas šajā apakšgrupā - Čehija, Ķīna un Itālija - ir nonākušas ļoti spēcīgā kompānijā un vismaz vienai valstsvienībai neizdosies kvalificēties play-off. Nomināli otra augstākā komanda no šīs grupas reitingā ir Ķīna, tad seko Čehija un Itālija. Ķīnietes pat iepriekšējā finālturnīrā tika līdz finālam, kur zaudēja ASV izlasei, kaut pēdējā laikā vismaz reitingā ķīnietes nedaudz atpaliek arī no Francijas un Austrālijas. Reitings gan ir viena lieta, bet kas ir kas, paradīs finālturnīra spēles.

programme.title: Vienmēr formā!
programme.desc: Deutsche Welle žurnāls.

programme.title: Aizliegtais paņēmiens
programme.desc: Lai uzzinātu par kāda notikuma patiesajiem apstākļiem vai iesaistīto personu nodomiem, raidījuma "Aizliegtais paņēmiens" komanda informācijas iegūšanai izmanto visdažādākos izmeklējošās žurnālistikas paņēmienus un žanrus – eksperimentus, testus, provokācijas, padziļinātus pētījumus, arī anonīmas intervijas. Žurnālisti padziļināti pēta un skatītājiem atklāj sociālpolitiskus tematus, kas ne vienmēr tiek izcelti citos medijos. Raidījums atklāj un atmasko, atsevišķos gadījumos sauc pie atbildības iesaistītās personas, norāda uz likumu nepilnībām, aicina mainīt pastāvošo kārtību, ja tā ir pretrunā sabiedrības interesēm. Raidījumu vada LTV Ziņu dienesta žurnālists Guntis Bojārs.

programme.title: Dubultais kritiens
programme.desc: Kad pirmā tiesas prāva pret Emīlu Siljersu par viņa sievas slepkavības mēģinājumu beidzās bez sprieduma, tika noteikta atkārtota lietas izskatīšana. Izmeklētāji zināja, ka vairs nevar paļauties uz Siljersa sievas liecību, jo viņa bija nostājusies vīra pusē, kurš ar viņu manipulēja. Tādēļ izmeklētāji izpētīja visu Siljersa dzīvi, uzvedību un attieksmi pret bijušajām un esošajām partnerēm, lai pierādītu viņa vainu. Pat pēc tiesas prāvas beigām Siljersa sievas ceļš ārā no kontrolējošām attiecībām bija garš un sarežģīts.

programme.title: Nāve paradīzē
programme.desc: Modele Zoja tiek nožņaugta dažas minūtes pēc noiešanas no mēles. Visiem viņas kolēģiem, dizaineram, trīs modelēm un fotogrāfam ir neapšaubāmi alibi, jo aizkulises visu laiku tika apsargātas. Vienīgais pavediens - zeķe, kas sažņaugta upura plaukstā.

programme.title: Dzīve savvaļā kopā ar Benu Fouglu
programme.desc: Britu dēkainis Bens Fougls šajā dokumentālo filmu ciklā dodas ceļā, lai iepazītos ar cilvēkiem, kas pagriezuši muguru drudžainajam dzīves ritmam un sabiedrībai un nolēmuši vadīt noslēgtu dzīvi neparastās vietās savvaļā saskaņā ar dabu un bez komunālajiem pakalpojumiem. Ceļojums Benu aizvedīs gan uz dažādām interesantām vietām Lielbritānijā, gan uz Islandi. Bens vienu nedēļu mēģinās iejusties viņu dzīvē un piedalīties viņu nodarbēs, katru reizi atklājot un iemācoties kaut ko jaunu.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Gaetāns Filjons tiek nogalināts, Stefans arestē Fransuā Labellu. Ne Sonja, ne Gabriela neuzticas Veronikai Lenuārai Romano lietā. Stefans brīdina Briēru, ka "Sixers" var atriebties gan viņiem abiem, gan Lorānam. Nansijai tiek noteikts tuvošanās liegums Bruno, viņa izseko Bruno dzīvesbiedri Martinu.

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: Izmeklētāja Vera ir parasta sieviete neparastā amatā. Mācījusies no skarbākajām dzīves dienām, viņa saglabā optimistisku skatu uz pasauli. Viņai ir laba humora izjūta un viņa ir ļoti piezemēta – izmeklētājai nepiemīt ne kripatas uzpūtības, lai gan viņa var būt skarba pret padotajiem. Dziļi sirdī viņa slēpj gadiem ilgušu vientulību, taču ārēji to slēpj aiz skarbas ironijas maskas. Veras lomu atveido aktrise Brenda Bletina, kas ir vairākkārt nominēta Oskaram, tā skaitā par lomu Maika Lī filmā "Noslēpumi un meli", par kuru arī ieguvusi "Zelta Globusu".

programme.title: Melnais saraksts
programme.desc: Kritiķu un skatītāju iemīļots kriminālseriāls. Tā darbība sākas dienā, kad darbu FIB galvenajā birojā Vašingtonā uzsāk jauna profilētāja Elizabete Kīna. Tajā pašā rītā tur ierodas viens no FIB meklētākajiem noziedzniekiem, Reimonds "Reds" Redingtons, un labprātīgi ļauj sevi notvert. Reds palīdz FIB sagūstīt citu bīstamu noziedznieku un novērst uzbrukumu civiliedzīvotājiem. Viņš paziņo, ka viņam esot vesels saraksts un informācija par tādiem noziedzniekiem un teroristiem, par kuru esamību FIB pat nenojauš. Reds ir gatavs sadarboties ar vienu savādu noteikumu – viņš runās tikai ar Elizabeti. Tā sākas īpašas attiecības, kuru īstā daba un iemesls ir zināmi tikai Redingtonam. Lai gan pamatā seriāla darbība norit ASV, tas aizved arī uz dažādām eksotiskām vietām visā pasaulē un ļauj ieskatīties kriminālajā pasaulē. Dažādiem apbalvojumiem vairāku gadu laikā izvirzīti seriāla specefektu veidotāji, kaskadieri un muzikālais noformējums.

programme.title: Nakts reiss
programme.desc: Londonas detektīve Hana Lī ir norīkota pavadīt doktoru Metjū Nolanu uz Pekinu, kur viņš tiek apsūdzēts smagā noziegumā. Taču 357. nakts reisā uz Ķīnu Hana saprot, ka šis uzdevums nebūt nebūs tik vienkāršs – lidojuma laikā viņa tiek ierauta sarežģītā sazvērestībā, kurā neko nevar uztvert par pašsaprotamu. Nolans apgalvo, ka ir nevainīgs, bet Hana apšauba visu, ko līdz šim zinājusi, un to, kas ir viņas patiesie sabiedrotie. Nezināmi ienaidnieki vēlas panākt, lai Nolans nekad nesasniegtu galamērķi, bet Hana kļūst par mērķi tiem, kuri vēlas noslēpt patiesību par Nolana pagātni. Spriedzei pieaugot, lidmašīnā parādās pirmās slepkavības, un Hana saprot, ka atklājumi, kas viņu sagaida, var maksāt gan viņas, gan Nolana dzīvību.

programme.title: Sisi
programme.desc: Seriāls "Sisi" ir patiesos notikumos balstīts intrigu pilns stāsts par slavenās pēdējās Austroungārijas imperatores Elizabetes jeb Sisi vētrainajiem dzīves līkločiem. Ar ķeizarienes statusu, leģendāro skaistumu, beznosacījuma brīvības mīlestību un solījumu piešķirt Habsburgu monarhijai žēlsirdīgāku imidžu Sisi vairāk nekā pusgadsimtu ir apbūrusi visu Eiropu un miljoniem cilvēku. Jaunais seriāls, kas uzņemts Austrijā, Latvijā, Lietuvā un Ungārijā, galveno uzmanību pievērš Elizabetes jaunības gadiem, viņas mīlas stāstam ar imperatoru Franci Jozefu, mēģinājumiem iekļauties Austrijas galmā un pastāvīgo konfrontāciju ar erchercogieni Sofiju. Sisi bija ne tikai sieva un māte, bet arī iekaroja savu vietu valsts politiskajā dzīvē, dodot lielu ieguldījumu diplomātijas kompromisu mākslā un Austroungārijas monarhijas dzimšanā.

programme.desc: Deutsche Welle žurnāls.

programme.title: Ekspedīcija Sumatrā
programme.desc: Ekspedīcijas sērijās uzzināsim ne tikai par mentavaju īpašajiem tetovējumiem un mūsdienu dzīvi, bet arī nokļūsim pasaules lielākā vulkāna krāterī, noskaidrosim, vai tiešām tā dēļ iestājās pēdējais ledus laikmets, pagaršosim kafiju vietā, kur iegūst pasaules dārgāko kafiju Kopi luwak un iepazīsimies ar daudziem interesantiem Malajas arhipelāga salu iedzīvotājiem.

programme.title: Ekspedīcija Sumatrā
programme.desc: Ekspedīcijas sērijās uzzināsim ne tikai par mentavaju īpašajiem tetovējumiem un mūsdienu dzīvi, bet arī nokļūsim pasaules lielākā vulkāna krāterī, noskaidrosim, vai tiešām tā dēļ iestājās pēdējais ledus laikmets, pagaršosim kafiju vietā, kur iegūst pasaules dārgāko kafiju Kopi luwak un iepazīsimies ar daudziem interesantiem Malajas arhipelāga salu iedzīvotājiem.

programme.title: Ielas garumā
programme.desc: Pasta sala simbolizē jauno Jelgavu - tā ir sporta, atpūtas un izklaides vieta starp Lielupi un Driksu iepretī pilsētas vēsturiskajam simbolam Svētās Trīsvienības baznīcas tornim un Jāņa Čakstes bulvārim, pa kuru, gluži kā dziesmā, ,"kāds students klīst"'. No pilsētas puses gājējus un riteņbraucējus salā ieved Baltijas mērogā unikālas konstrukcijas vanšu tilts, kam jelgavnieki devuši pilsētas seno vārdu - Mītavas tilts. Lielu popularitāti ir iemantojuši starptautiskie ledus un smilšu skulptūru festivāli, kas notiek salā. Vasarās veiklie kuģīši met lokus ap salu, ļaujot iepazīt tās dzīvi no neierasta skatpunkta. Katrai ēkai Pasta salā ir savs interesants tapšanas stāsts, bet īsta pērle zem gliemežvāka jumta ir brīvdabas koncertzāle Mītava.

programme.title: Kultūršoks
programme.desc: Kultūra ir ne vien māksla, bet arī nauda, projekti, ražošana un gan radoši, gan postoši konflikti. Par kultūrvides problēmām un šokējošām atklāsmēm — raidījums "Kultūršoks".

programme.title: Vides fakti
programme.desc: Raidījums par norisēm dabā un apkārtējā vidē. "Vides fakti" sniedz informāciju par sezonālām norisēm dabā un dzīvnieku pasaulē, par vides aktualitātēm, par videi draudzīgu dzīvesveidu, par aktuālām cilvēka un vides attiecībām ārpus Latvijas robežām. Raidījumā "Vides fakti" ir skatāmi arī piedzīvojumu sižeti par aktīvā tūrisma iespējām Latvijā, kā arī īsfilmas par neparastiem ceļojumiem pasaulē.

programme.title: De facto
programme.desc: LTV Ziņu dienesta veidotajā analītiski pētnieciskajā raidījumā "De Facto" skatītājiem nozīmīgus jautājumus izmeklē žurnālisti Matīss Arnicāns, Inga Šņore, Laine Fedotova, Ivo Leitāns un Ella Semjonova. "De Facto" uzmanības lokā ir netaisnības un pretrunas – ne tikai korupcijas, interešu konfliktu un citu noziedzīgu nodarījumu lietas, bet arī sabiedrībai būtisku cieņpilnas attieksmes un ētiskas rīcības pārkāpumu izmeklēšana.

programme.title: Pasaules panorāma
programme.desc: Globālo ziņu laikmetā notikums Āzijā vai Amerikas kontinentā jau rīt var mainīt dzīvi Eiropā, bet lēmums, kas pieņemts Rīgā – atbalsoties visā pasaulē. "Pasaules panorāma" piedāvā neatkarīgas un uzticamas ziņas, atspoguļojot un analizējot ārpolitikas aktualitātes, kā arī sarunas ar politologiem, ārpolitikas ekspertiem, pasaulē pazīstamām personībām par svarīgāko Baltijā un Ziemeļvalstīs, citviet Eiropā, kā arī visā pasaulē. Raidījumu vada LTV Ziņu dienesta ārzemju ziņu redaktori Toms Pastors un Ina Strazdiņa.

programme.title: Mērdoka noslēpumi
programme.desc: Notiek pārdroša bankas pajūga aplaupīšana, kuras laikā viens no zagļiem nogalina otru. Mērdoks sastopas ar neparastu liecinieku – cilvēku, kurš sevi dēvē par Šerloku Holmsu. Viņš ne tikai aktīvi iesaistās izmeklēšanā, bet arī ir pārliecināts, ka notikušo noziegumu noorganizējis Moriartijs.

programme.title: Mērdoka noslēpumi
programme.desc: Netālu no natūristu apmetnes, kas pieder Helmutam Lindemanam un viņa sievai Airīnai, tiek atrasts vīrieša līķis. Taču kopiena neuzticas cilvēkiem no malas un policijai, tāpēc Krebtrijam nākas tajā iefiltrēties. Lai Ogdena varētu šķirt laulību ar Dārsiju, nepieciešami pierādījumi, ka viņa viņam nav uzticīga.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans: Deep Dive
programme.desc: War...Weather...and human error have led to some of the worst maritime disasters in US history. But imagine if we could empty the oceans, letting the water drain away to reveal these secrets of Americas sea floor. Pearl Harbor, who fired the first shot? What are the dangerous forces that make Alcatraz and the San Francisco Bay so deadly? And how did drilling for oil result in one of the biggest environmental disasters in US history? Drained dry we reveal these sunken mysteries along Americas shores.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: The Age of Dinosaurs - an ancient world of savage, lone T-rexes terrorizing dopey plant-eating diplodocus. So familiar… but so wrong. From the colours of their skin to the way they flock and herd, so much of what we think is true about dinosaurs is either out of date, guesswork, or all-out fantasy. Now a new generation of palaeontologists, armed with the latest tech, are challenging these popular caricatures to uncover the Real Jurassic Americas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: En route to Boise, Idaho, Continental Airlines Flight 1713 is delayed on the tarmac in Denver where controllers struggle to keep departures on schedule amid heavy snow. When the plane is finally cleared for take-off, the DC-9 barely lifts off the ground before its banks sharply and crashes. Investigators find nothing wrong with the aircraft itself, but what they eventually uncover changes commercial flight forever.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: August 22nd, 1985 British Airtours Flight #28 is taking off from Manchester Airport for the Greek Island of Corfu. As the aircraft is accelerating, a loud thud emanates from the fuselage, and the pilots abandon takeoff. They believe a tire has blown, but passengers on the left side of the plane see the real problem one of the engines is on fire. Soon, thick black smoke fills the cabin, panicked passengers struggle to escape, and just minutes later, the aircraft is completely ravaged by fire. 55 people die. Can investigators determine how a minor emergency turned into one of the worst disasters in British aviation history?

programme.title: Last of the Giants
programme.desc: Cyril and his team embark on an unprecedented adventure in the wildest, dangerous and unexplored regions of the world. Their mission: to find the last endangered species of giant fish and take samples for scientific purposes in order to better understand the exact causes of their disappearance. Their challenge: survive in hostile environments and extreme conditions to protect these impressive aquatic creatures.

programme.title: Last of the Giants
programme.desc: Cyrils next mission is the invasive paiche, a giant, air-breathing monster fish that can grow to twice the length of an adult human. He charters a plane to a remote Bolivian lake and drops a bait near a floating island of weeds and a sledgehammer blow hits his line. As Cyril begins to fight, he and his team must jump into their tiny boat in order to chase the explosive paiche. No missteps, no broken lines. Cyril has got what he came to get: a true giant.

programme.title: Situation Critical
programme.desc: On Friday, June 2nd 1995, Captain Scott O'Grady is patrolling a NATO no-fly zone over Bosnia when his F-16 aircraft bursts into flames after being hit by a Bosnian Serb missile. The fighter pilot ejects from his disintegrating plane and parachutes to earth, landing deep in hostile territory. With armed militia hot on his heels, OGrady dives into the undergrowth. Moments later his pursuers pass five feet from his head. For six days, OGrady evades capture, moving only by night, desperately trying to establish radio contact with his comrades. On the sixth night, a pilot from OGradys air base finally hears his radio call, setting into motion a daring, daylight rescue mission by U.S. Marines.

programme.title: Situation Critical
programme.desc: A fleet of 115 yachts sets off on the gruelling 630-mile course of the Sydney to Hobart yacht race. Twenty-six hours into the race and every competitors fear becomes a reality - a weather bomb explodes in the treacherous waters of Bass Strait. Even the sturdiest of yachts are hammered by 70-knot winds and 100-foot waves, as one of the greatest ocean challenges becomes a desperate race for survival. Countless racing yachts are capsized, sunk or simply left stranded. Australian authorities must now launch one of the largest peacetime rescue operation the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: En route to Boise, Idaho, Continental Airlines Flight 1713 is delayed on the tarmac in Denver where controllers struggle to keep departures on schedule amid heavy snow. When the plane is finally cleared for take-off, the DC-9 barely lifts off the ground before its banks sharply and crashes. Investigators find nothing wrong with the aircraft itself, but what they eventually uncover changes commercial flight forever.

programme.title: Situation Critical
programme.desc: In a single moment, life can transform from routine to critical. One bullet, one alarm or one misstep can spur tragedy — and plunge average people and trained experts alike into desperate circumstances. In Situation Critical, we explore the unfolding action and the real people thrust into survivor mode by some of the most dramatic events in modern history. This fast-paced series takes you inside the seemingly stable events that became headline disasters in a matter of minutes. Each hour-long episode combines archival footage, accurate re-enactments, advanced CGI and firsthand accounts from those at the centre of the action. This is the second-deadliest airplane disaster in US history... But can investigators determine what went wrong?

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Car SOS is back for a sixth series with parts blagging petrolhead Tim Shaw and master mechanic Fuzz Townshend breathing life into classic cars for unsuspecting owners. This series yet another array of iconic cars including a 1990s Lancia Delta Integrale, a 60s Citroen DS, an 80s Peugeot 205 Rally car and a 1950s MGA. Special guests this series include actor James Nesbitt and Monte Carlo legend Paddy Hopkirk.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz take on a 1989 VW Golf GTi, one of the most iconic cars to have come out of the 1980s and one which just happens to be Tim Shaw's all-time favourite car. The boys challenge this time is to make this particular Golf suitable for its owner Darren, a former bus driver who was left disabled and partially sighted after a tragic road accident in which he saved the life of his young grandson.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Today Tim and Fuzz are off to Leeds to take on one of the most beautiful British sports cars that no one has ever heard of: the AC Aceca. Most people are aware of the AC Cobra, but not many know about its predecessor the incredibly rare and extremely valuable Aceca. Today's car has been kept and loved by its owner Monet since the early 70s, however years of suffering ill health has meant his beloved car has ended up rotting away in his garage. Monet's son Richard wrote in to Car SOS in the hope that the team could give a new lease of life to his Dad by stealing the car away and surprising him with a fully restored motor. The boys oblige and set to task on what turns out to be one of the most heartwarming stories and certainly most beautiful, finished cars to date.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Today Tim and Fuzz are off to West Sussex to rescue an iconic 1970s motor - the first truly successful Japanese car export - the mighty Datsun 240z. Retired GP Paul has owned and loved his car since it was virtually new however when the car started needing too much work it ended up in Paul's garage rotting away while he put his work in the community first . Paul's family wrote in to Car SOS in the hope Tim and Fuzz would be able to repay their Dad for the years of help he has brought to others by fully restoring his beloved car. However what at first looks like a bit of a breeze for the boys turns into a right old rust storm. Will they get the car back to Paul in time ?

programme.title: Gladiators: Warriors of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Emperor Commodus shocks Rome by casting aside tradition and becoming a gladiator. Over 14 days of extravagant games, he slays wild beasts, spars with helpless opponents, and indulges his fantasy of godhood - dressed as Hercules, demanding adoration. Behind the spectacle lies growing discontent: the Senate scorned, the treasury drained, and power abused, as he trains as a gladiator in his country estate. When Commodus plans to inaugurate the new year from the gladiators' barracks, his inner circle panics. Poisoned by his mistress Marcia and strangled by his trainer Narcissus, Commodus dies; a far cry from the hero he imagined. His death sparks civil war, ushering in the Severan dynasty. His legacy is condemned, and Commodus remains one of the most bizarre figures in Roman history, an emperor who tried to rule from the arena, not the throne.

programme.title: Gladiators: Warriors of the Ancient World
programme.desc: In the later Roman Empire it was gladiators and emperors alike frequently came from overseas. Emperor Septimius Severus was born in Africa and his wife in Syria, as was a gladiator named Flamma who was captured and sent to fight in Sicily. There, in the ludus, he fights alongside fellow gladiators such as Delicatus, forging bonds that define his career. His epitaph records 34 fights: 21 victories, 9 draws, and only 4 defeats. After his final bout, he dies at the age of 30. His gravestone exposes not only the brutal realities of gladiatorial life but also the comradeship and loyalty of the gladiators. Flamma's story embodies the grandeur, violence, and complexity of Rome's obsession with bloodsport.

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: At Australia's busiest airport which operates 24/7, a blackout halts operations and Resource Coordinator Andrew tries to restore power within an hour. Air Traffic Controller Melissa manages up to 700 daily plane movements. A flight must dump fuel and return to the airport after take-off due to a faulty engine warning.

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: Brad and the ground services team have just 90 minutes to turn around an Air India flight for take-off. A kangaroo in the car park keeps ground transport manager Trent on his toes. Environment officer Dave discovers illegal bee hives within the airport precinct, and baggage handler Brodie battles carousel jams.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Moments after taking off from a windswept Norwegian island, the pilots of Widerøe Flight 839 hear a disturbing noise and then struggle to keep their plane level. And—after only 65 seconds in the air—their twin turboprop nosedives into the North Atlantic, killing everyone on board. In the wreckage, investigators discover damage to a critical steering component. And when they learn that another Widerøe flight nearly met the same fate at Værøy's notoriously tricky airport, they diagnose a perfect storm of controversial decisions that put lives at ris

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Repatriating Indian nationals from Dubai in the midst of the COVID-19 epidemic, Air India Express Flight 1344 is on final approach to Calicut airport amid heavy showers, reduced visibility, and strong winds. The treacherous tabletop runway leaves no margin for error. And after a first missed attempt, the Boeing 737-800 touches down—yet fails to stop—and plunges into a gorge. The aircraft breaks apart on impact, killing 21 people, including the two pilots. At first, investigators suspect a problem with the braking system. But they soon discover a shocking malfunction of an entirely different nature. For some reason, the aircraft came in above the glide slope, flew well past the touchdown zone, and ran out of runway. And the fatal cause is logged on the cockpit voice recorder.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Korean Air Flight 6316 is en route to Seoul with a load of non-hazardous cargo. But shortly after takeoff, the pilots struggle to navigate the skies above Shanghai. The controller notices the plane isn't climbing to its assigned altitude. And within minutes, the MD-11F disappears from radar altogether and slams into a residential neighborhood. The massive impact registers the equivalent of a 1.6-magnitude earthquake, destroys the flight data recorder, and claims the lives of five civilians and the three-man crew. Investigators from China, South Korea, and the US join forces, and are soon able to rule out both mechanical issues and sabotage. It's only when they reconstruct the flight in a simulator that the mystery begins to unravel—and they come to a startling realization.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Angkor: Ancient Laos Revealed
programme.desc: A team of archaeologists investigate a priceless hoard of ancient treasure discovered in Laos. Their quest takes them to temple sites in the southeast Asian jungle as they try to find out who the stunning treasure belonged to and what it was used for. Astonishing new discoveries of gold and human remains open a window into the early years of the civilisation that built the great city of Angkor.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Angkor: Ancient Laos Revealed
programme.desc: An international team of archaeologists investigate a hoard of priceless ancient treasure discovered in the southeast Asian nation of Laos. Their mission takes them to temple sites in the jungle. Aerial scanning technology targets new areas for excavation where astonishing new discoveries are made as they as they explore the origins of the civilisation that built the great city of Angkor.

programme.title: Northwoods Survival
programme.desc: Margot takes advantage of the milder Yukon weather and tries her hand at a few new wilderness DIY projects; In the hopes of making his life in the bush "easier" - Matty digs deep - and searches for a less labor-intensive source of water. To accommodate the arrival of a few "four-legged" friends, Billy works on upgrading his backwoods property; And Emilie and Gilbert head into the wilds of Ontario - on the hunt for a source of spring-time sustenance.

programme.title: Northwoods Survival
programme.desc: Facing a spate of thunderstorms, Margot makes one final, all out push to complete her Yukon dream home. Billy builds a backwoods BBQ - the last step in his goal to turn his simple abode into the perfect wilderness homestead. With summer right around the corner, Matty takes steps to "up" his waterfront "game". And Emilie and Gilbert battle late season snows as they rush to complete their backcountry cabin before some very special guests arrive.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: The oldest and youngest carriers from Airport Security Colombia and Peru. A woman with cocaine and a record. 19-year-old student carries to help his sick mother. A 19-year-old woman claims her aunt tricked her. An old man cannot believe he is carrying, and neither can the relative he calls. An old man from the Marshall Islands may be part of a trend to enlist the elderly as carriers. A young Venezuelan man risks it all due to conditions at home.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: These carriers are frequent flyers. From Airport Security Colombia and Peru, a Spaniard with cocaine pretends to be shocked. A man going to the DR with cocaine tells officers he has been there before. A man on his second trip claims he was forced. A woman uses someone else's authentic passport to travel. An Indonesian woman carries cocaine and multiple types of currency. A freelance trafficker boasts he has information on a 1000 kilo load.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: During a regional commuter hop in New Zealand, the pilots of Eagle Airways Flight 2300 struggle to lower their landing gear. They circle the airport to troubleshoot the issue. Low on fuel, they have no choice but to eventually attempt a wheels-up landing. With emergency crews standing by, their twin-engine turboprop gently touches down, slides along the centre of the runway, and comes to a stop—remarkably with no injuries and minimal damage to the aircraft. With a potential disaster narrowly averted, investigators look into what could have caused the landing gear to fail. They soon track a hydraulic leak to a minor part with a major flaw. When they later test the entire fleet of Beechcraft turboprops, they uncover a systemic issue that's endangering passengers worldwide.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: The Coastguard follow a smugglers' trail and make a remarkable discovery. A family in danger is rescued from a delicate situation. The Customs Surveillance team joins forces with their French colleagues to carry out a special operation on the island of Madeira. And in the Mediterranean Sea, divers work to protect historical Roman artefacts, while a sailing race may end in disaster.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: Cameras that monitor the coastline alert the coastguard to a well-known drug trafficker who seems to be back in action near Cadiz. Three patrol boats round up tobacco smugglers near Gibraltar, while another unit tracks down human traffickers off Cabo de Gata.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: The show that combines cold hard science with some of the craziest, most spectacular and painful user generated clips ever recorded is back for a third season. Richard Hammond introduces a host of new mishaps featuring brave, if misguided individuals from around the world and then explains the science behind their failure and humiliation with the use of bespoke animations and super slo-mo cinematography. Each week we show between 50 and 60 clips of misadventure - ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes. Each episode will feature several themes such as motorbike drifting, wakeboarding or attempting to fly drones. Clips are paused, re-wound, and re-played as we analyse exactly what went wrong and why. Richard Hammond explains the physics, chemistry and biology at play, by presenting forensic detail to explain the stupidity that resulted in failure. He'll study everything from acceleration to aero dynamics, fluid pressure to combustion and human anatomy to flammability. This is misadventure explained. This is The Science of Stupid.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: US Air Flight #1493 (Boeing 737-300) & Skywest Flight #5569 (Fairchild Metroliner) February 1st, 1991 Its a busy night at Los Angeles International Airport, and US Air Flight #1493 is on its final approach. The pilots configure the 737 for landing and although they repeatedly radio the tower for instructions, their calls go unanswered. They finally get clearance just moments before landing, but within seconds of touching down, the aircraft erupts in flames and crashes into an abandoned building. Rescue workers rush to the scene, and as survivors emerge from the inferno, firefighters make a horrifying discovery... Can investigators determine what went wrong?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: September 1, 1983 Korean Air Lines Flight #007 is high above the Sea of Japan with 269 people on board. Hoping to save fuel during the last leg of its marathon flight from New York to Seoul, it requests permission to fly at a higher altitude. When the aircraft reaches its new altitude, however, it is rocked by rapid decompression, spirals out of control and crashes into the sea. An international controversy erupts, and within days, Soviet officials admit to shooting down the passenger plane. With Cold War tensions at an all-time high, its up to international investigators to keep two superpowers at bay. But can they prevent an all-out armed conflict, and can they determine what went wrong?

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: Extreme weather patterns have threatened ships and mariners for centuries. The perfect storm?. towering walls of water, powerful winds and churning seas can overwhelm any ship. What brought down the largest haul of Spanish treasure off the coast of Florida? And what's the truth behind the strange disappearance of the mightiest invasion force of ancient times? Drain the Oceans reveals the secrets of Stormy Seas.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans: Deep Dive
programme.desc: War...Weather...and human error have led to some of the worst maritime disasters in US history. But imagine if we could empty the oceans, letting the water drain away to reveal these secrets of Americas sea floor. Pearl Harbor, who fired the first shot? What are the dangerous forces that make Alcatraz and the San Francisco Bay so deadly? And how did drilling for oil result in one of the biggest environmental disasters in US history? Drained dry we reveal these sunken mysteries along Americas shores.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Under the muck of a Danish bog, a 2,400-year-old body is found so perfectly preserved the stubble on the dead man's chin is visible … as is the rope around his neck. Is this ancient cold case what it seems? At the turn of the 20th century, physician Albert Abrams was inspired to apply the new discovery of radio waves to medicine. He invented a complex-looking machine to diagnose any disease. Thousands flocked to be tested, but the establishment was skeptical. At Berlin's Neues Museum, a bust of Egypt's Queen Nefertiti portrays a woman so stunning that she has become synonymous with flawless beauty. But when experts use advanced techniques to look beneath the surface, new questions are raised about the queen's appearance.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: The lost colony of Roanoke is a historic mystery that has not been solved for over 400 years. An intriguing artifact was discovered in 1937: the Dare Stone. Apparently written by John White, it explains in detail what happened to the vanished colony. But is it real? World War I was the first major conflict to feature warplanes and, therefore, also the first to feature anti-air defence. How did an object resembling a satellite dish on wheels help gunners shoot down enemy planes? In Egypt, excavations of the Great Sphinx of Giza in 1817 uncovered six carved hunks of stone. Put together, they appear to be fragments of a large, braided stone beard, in the style of false beards worn by ancient pharaohs. The Sphinx never wore a beard … or did it?

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: SAIL Amsterdam is the largest nautical event in the world, held in the capital once every five years. Around 800 historic ships and impressive tall ships sail along the IJ River past Amsterdam Central Station. Amsterdam Central Station staff expects an additional 150,000 passengers, making it one of the busiest days of the year. To ensure the enormous influx of visitors doesn't lead to dangerous congestion, station manager René and safety coordinator Bas oversee crowd control. They have to pull out all the stops, especially after the fireworks show ends in the evening. For the Safety & Service team, it's all hands on deck. Menno and Baran are busy dealing with alcohol-related incidents of collapse and aggression.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: Over two days in spring of 1996, 8 climbers died on the descent from Mount Everest. A fierce storm, hubris and ambition and a series of errors contributed to make this the deadliest day in the history of the mountain. On May 10th two competing commercial guided expeditions were making the ascent to Everest. Adventure Consultants led by New Zealand climbing veteran Rob Hall and Mountain Madness led by accomplished American climber Scott Fischer led clients, each of whom paid up to $65,000, to summit the peak. Dr Jeremy Windsor a leading expert on altitude will examine the dangers posed by climbing at such a high altitude where oxygen in the air is three times less than sea level, and reveals weather data that may have uniquely contributed to the tragedy

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: In February 1998 a US Marine Corps prowler jet took off for a routine training mission through the Italian Alps. On the final leg of its flight the aircraft's right wing sliced through the supporting cable of a ski gondola filled with tourists. The gondola plummeted over 100m to the valley floor and all 20 passengers perished. The prowler jet was severely damaged but the pilot made it back the 90kilometres to their base. Seconds from Disaster investigates the causes and repercussions of the crash and speaks exclusively with a member of the aircrew who, alongside the investigators and victims' families, are all still haunted by this tragedy.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Three real world disasters forensically analysed and dissected in astonishing detail using 3D graphics, expert analysis and all available evidence. Why did the space shuttle Challenger explode just 73 seconds after launch? Was there a fatal flaw in the spacecraft's design? What part did weather conditions play in the tragedy? Did people conceal the risks? Should they have launched at all? Why did a cabin on the Italian Stresa cable packed with 15 people suddenly shoot downhill just metres from the summit? What went wrong? Were safety systems disabled? Was the disaster avoidable? What caused the collapse of the vast ice rink roof at Bad Reichenhall in Germany while families were still skating underneath? Was it a design flaw? Poor maintenance? Or extreme weather?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: At the end of a four-month deployment in Guam, a two-officer crew prepares to fly back to the states in one of the world's most sophisticated warplanes: the B-2 Spirit bomber. But immediately after takeoff, the plane pitches up dramatically, losing speed and shaking violently. The pilots quickly eject from the stealth bomber just before it crashes to Earth. With a price tag of two billion dollars, it's the most expensive aviation accident of all time, and investigators are under pressure to determine what happened... and if it could happen again.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Outside Draskow, Poland, an undocumented cemetery hundreds of years old is found in 2010 containing a woman's skeleton with a blade on her stomach, a stone on her neck and a green color in her mouth. Was this strange burial a precaution against the living dead? During the cold war, the United States developed a surveillance tool that was the first of its kind—code name: Project Corona. Did the shiny golden dome really help avert nuclear Armageddon? Countless literati have studied Shakespeare's plays for his profound prose, but what about for secret-coded messages? In the 1800s, Dr. Orville Ward Owen built a hulking wooden machine to do just that and concluded that Shakespeare was not who we think. Does his theory stand up to scrutiny?

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: The shroud of Turin is one of the most debated archaeological artifacts in the world. Is it the burial cloth of the Christian messiah, Jesus of Nazareth, or is it an elaborate fake? Every time the evidence points one way or another, a credible counter argument is raised. In the collective imagination of the mid-20th century, jetpacks were the personalized transportation of the future. American engineer Wendell Moore really did develop and test a model for the military, so why don't we all have one? Buried for 2,400 years, a pair of beautiful cups are discovered in a grave mound made by Scythians, an ancient civilization of the Caucasus Mountains. What can the cups be for if they have holes in the bottom? And why are they solid gold?

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: One of the world's deadliest natural disasters wreaks havoc across the Spanish province of Valencia in a flash. Cable car rides go from scenic to scary in a snap, an airport parking garage in the UK goes up in flames, and the canopy of a Serbian train station comes down with a bang. A large Romanian bridge has even bigger construction problems, and a few British bike paths have questionable design decisions.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: An oversized billboard falls down in Mumbai, causing death and destruction. In Minnesota, too much snow leads to roofs collapsing. A volcano erupts, creating widespread infrastructure damage. A bridge in Pittsburgh plummets to the valley below, taking with it cars and a bus. While digging new subway tunnels in São Paulo, the ground caves in, not once, but twice. Home renovations spark outrage, and eerie abandoned skyscrapers, or "ghost-scrapers," remain unfinished.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Three real world disasters forensically analysed and dissected in astonishing detail using 3D graphics, expert analysis and all available evidence. Why does the Greek ferry MV Samina drift so far off course that it collides with a well marked rock just minutes from its final destination? Why does it sink in less than an hour? Was a massive explosion in AZF in Toulouse, a French fertiliser factory caused by terrorism, chemical contamination or damp weather? Why did it devastate an entire suburb? What triggered the sudden collapse of a 40-year-old road bridge? Was it a design flaw? Corrosive chemicals? Or overloading?

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Three real world disasters forensically analysed and dissected in astonishing detail using 3D graphics, expert analysis and all available evidence. Why did the space shuttle Challenger explode just 73 seconds after launch? Was there a fatal flaw in the spacecraft's design? What part did weather conditions play in the tragedy? Did people conceal the risks? Should they have launched at all? Why did a cabin on the Italian Stresa cable packed with 15 people suddenly shoot downhill just metres from the summit? What went wrong? Were safety systems disabled? Was the disaster avoidable? What caused the collapse of the vast ice rink roof at Bad Reichenhall in Germany while families were still skating underneath? Was it a design flaw? Poor maintenance? Or extreme weather?

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: The shroud of Turin is one of the most debated archaeological artifacts in the world. Is it the burial cloth of the Christian messiah, Jesus of Nazareth, or is it an elaborate fake? Every time the evidence points one way or another, a credible counter argument is raised. In the collective imagination of the mid-20th century, jetpacks were the personalized transportation of the future. American engineer Wendell Moore really did develop and test a model for the military, so why don't we all have one? Buried for 2,400 years, a pair of beautiful cups are discovered in a grave mound made by Scythians, an ancient civilization of the Caucasus Mountains. What can the cups be for if they have holes in the bottom? And why are they solid gold?

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Outside Draskow, Poland, an undocumented cemetery hundreds of years old is found in 2010 containing a woman's skeleton with a blade on her stomach, a stone on her neck and a green color in her mouth. Was this strange burial a precaution against the living dead? During the cold war, the United States developed a surveillance tool that was the first of its kind—code name: Project Corona. Did the shiny golden dome really help avert nuclear Armageddon? Countless literati have studied Shakespeare's plays for his profound prose, but what about for secret-coded messages? In the 1800s, Dr. Orville Ward Owen built a hulking wooden machine to do just that and concluded that Shakespeare was not who we think. Does his theory stand up to scrutiny?

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: Construction cranes are towers in the sky - except when they collapse. Our first story examines three disasters in Seattle, Manhattan and Bangkok. Three disasters: three different reasons for collapse. We examine what went wrong. The Artz Pedregal Mall in Mexico City had only been open a few months before the cantilevered section of the structure came crashing to the street below. How could a brand new building fail so dramatically? What's so precarious about cantilever designs?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: US Air Flight #1493 (Boeing 737-300) & Skywest Flight #5569 (Fairchild Metroliner) February 1st, 1991 Its a busy night at Los Angeles International Airport, and US Air Flight #1493 is on its final approach. The pilots configure the 737 for landing and although they repeatedly radio the tower for instructions, their calls go unanswered. They finally get clearance just moments before landing, but within seconds of touching down, the aircraft erupts in flames and crashes into an abandoned building. Rescue workers rush to the scene, and as survivors emerge from the inferno, firefighters make a horrifying discovery... Can investigators determine what went wrong?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: September 1, 1983 Korean Air Lines Flight #007 is high above the Sea of Japan with 269 people on board. Hoping to save fuel during the last leg of its marathon flight from New York to Seoul, it requests permission to fly at a higher altitude. When the aircraft reaches its new altitude, however, it is rocked by rapid decompression, spirals out of control and crashes into the sea. An international controversy erupts, and within days, Soviet officials admit to shooting down the passenger plane. With Cold War tensions at an all-time high, its up to international investigators to keep two superpowers at bay. But can they prevent an all-out armed conflict, and can they determine what went wrong?

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: With the Coastguard in pursuit, drug traffickers throw their illegal cargo into the water to try and avoid capture. While working on another anti-drug operation, divers of the Special Unit for Subaquatic Activities must change plans quicky to attend to a potential drowning. And an illegal fishing boat takes cover in the darkness to try and evade capture.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: A routine surveillance check of fishing boats has unpredicted consequences. A suspicious speedboat immediately raises a red flag at headquarters. An interception team is dispatched to investigate. In the Balearic Islands, Coastguard teams are confronted with an unexpected case of alleged domestic violence.

programme.title: Situation Critical
programme.desc: In a single moment, life can transform from routine to critical. One bullet, one alarm or one misstep can spur tragedy — and plunge average people and trained experts alike into desperate circumstances. In Situation Critical, we explore the unfolding action and the real people thrust into survivor mode by some of the most dramatic events in modern history. This fast-paced series takes you inside the seemingly stable events that became headline disasters in a matter of minutes. Each hour-long episode combines archival footage, accurate re-enactments, advanced CGI and firsthand accounts from those at the centre of the action. Building suspense with each heart-pounding movement, we vividly break down the terrifying moments — outlining the life-threatening risks, daring decisions, frantic communications, evolving tactics and last-ditch efforts developing with each decisive tick of the clock. Don't miss as we follow the hunt for Colombian drug baron Pablo Escobar and the Russian sub rescue of 2005 orchestrated by the UK's Submarine Rescue Service.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bullshark
programme.desc: We know Bull Sharks swim upriver and we know they hunt in the sea. But we've never been able to see it all like this. We see them attack and consume other sharks. We watch their shady hunts in the deep. We follow them up freshwater rivers to pupping grounds. We see them hunt shoals of fish from drones above and we watch as they clash with hippos and crocs.

programme.title: Monsters of the Wild: Creepy Crawlers
programme.desc: Mother Nature…creator of breathtaking beauty. And it seems there's no end to her evolutionary inspirations…or perhaps? Twisted imagination. programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: The Boteti River is a vital, dry-season pitstop for the tens of thousands of animals that rely on its life-saving water during the annual migration between the Okavango Delta and the Makgadikgadi grasslands. When it unexpectedly stops flowing for 20 years, all life is forced to adapt to the reality of a long and enduring drought.

programme.title: Asia's Weirdest
programme.desc: Asia's natural world is full of weird wildlife. Expect the unexpected in places like no other, as the series heads to extraordinary locations including the rugged islands of Indonesia and the grasslands of Mongolia.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 1 of our series starts with the dust of the disappearing migration as it heads off across the river and leaves. Behind them, hundreds if not thousands of other animals cannot move, or won't move, because they are locked into territories, invisible barriers that say to them, 'leave your bubble at your peril'. This is their story. It is the story about what happens between September and the following July. Nine months of wildebeest-free Mara.

programme.title: Borneo's Secret Kingdom: Weird And Wild
programme.desc: Flowing from the heart of Borneo, the Kinabatangan River is a cornucopia of life. From deep within mountains, to its ultimate meeting with the sea. Borneo stands at a triple junction of three tectonic plates, and at the crossroads of two oceans. The river is home to 50 mammal species, 200 types of bird, and countless insects. Fuelled by yearly monsoons, at its headwaters, mountains have sustained wet tropical forests. In the floodplains below, strange and more unexpected life inhabits the dense jungle. Beyond lie tangled mangroves nursing the next generation of marine creatures. Finally, at the cusp of the Sulu Sea the journey begins again. In the tropical warmth, moisture evaporates, rises to form clouds, and on mountain ranges rain falls again.

programme.desc: In this special episode, follow the rare and deadly creatures adapted to survive in China's most extreme environments. Golden snub-nosed monkeys fight for their right to a family in the mountain forests. And in the ancient grasslands, danger comes in all shapes and sizes.

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Across Asia, young animals are born into a battle for survival and each day brings a new set of dangers. Macaques embark on treacherous journeys to find food. An adolescent leopard struggles while learning to hunt. Though they will grow to be apex predators, Komodo dragon hatchlings flee their cannibalistic elders. The risks are great and the reward even greater: the continuation of their species.

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: In picturesque rural Nebraska, husband and wife veterinary team Drs. Ben and Erin Schroeder live and work at the center of America's food chain, where the livelihoods of Midwestern farmers connect to families nationwide. Along with their two sons, Charlie and Chase, the Schroeder family is always on the go as their veterinary practice cares for the region's many animals in need. From winter blizzards to spring tornadoes and blistering summer heat waves, Drs. Ben and Erin overcome the obstacles with skill and heart.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: Combat in the sea takes viewers into the ocean's sparkling, tropical reefs … and rough open water. In our planet's liquid space, predators of all shapes and sizes face incredible obstacles to success - and survival, because underwater battlefields test the mettle of even the biggest and deadliest carnivores. All marine predators must overcome the sea's ever changing temperament, factor in its natural cycles … and for some, avoid becoming prey themselves. Regardless of temperature, depth, or terrain, each distinct marine habitat calls for different body designs, uniquely evolved senses, and outrageously complex - even bizarre - tactics for success.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: Combat in the sea takes viewers into the ocean's sparkling, tropical reefs … and rough open water. In our planet's liquid space, predators of all shapes and sizes face incredible obstacles to success - and survival, because underwater battlefields test the mettle of even the biggest and deadliest carnivores. All marine predators must overcome the sea's ever changing temperament, factor in its natural cycles … and for some, avoid becoming prey themselves. Regardless of temperature, depth, or terrain, each distinct marine habitat calls for different body designs, uniquely evolved senses, and outrageously complex - even bizarre - tactics for success.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: If you're a forest predator, success requires using trees to bridge the gap between life and death. In this realm, danger - or your next meal - could be behind you, below, or above you. Whether you're a Harpy eagle, zeroing in on prey from high in the rainforest canopy, a cunning weasel, scouring for a meal in and out of mossy logs, or a Bengal tiger, trying to stalk in a bare, dry forest, catching prey among the trees is a challenge.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: There are still places on Earth where fields of grass stretch as far as the eye can see. In order to survive in these open spaces, predators must hide in plain sight. On the vast plains of the African savanna, banded mongooses rely on strength in numbers in order to succeed in a land of giants. Cheetahs and secretary birds must conquer extreme heat and elusive prey, risking their lives to feed their offspring. Mongolian wolves hunt for scarce food on the steppe.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: Secret Life of Predators is a National Geography documentary series narrated by Boone Smith, exploring animals that are on the top of the food chains in the environments they inhabit, such as eagles, tigers and bears. Meet some of the deadliest creatures, from rainforests and African savannas to the depths of the ocean. Find out the strategies these animals use to fight for their survival, and why are these hunter species the most successful when it comes to it.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabo neprot zīmēt. Viņam piemetas žagas, no kurām netiek vaļā. Viņš jau grasās padoties, kad nejauši rada jaunu mākslas novirzienu. Barbaliba grib piedalīties rakstīšanas konkursā, taču brāļi un māsas neļauj koncentrēties.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabravo kā slepenais aģents vada izmeklēšanu, bruņojies ar saviem rīkiem, lai uzzinātu, kurš nozaga Barbatēta torti. Barbalala ir pārliecināta, ka dzirdēja milzu vistu klīstam pa māju. Barbabērni stāv sardzē.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Bizonu bars migrē caur Celtnieklīci un traucas tieši pretī Rātsnamam. Rabla komanda izmanto lielos braucamos, lai glābtu pilsētu. Komanda izmanto milzīgos braucamos, lai palīdzētu Lūkasam un Lilijai dāvāt vecākiem lieliskāko kāzu gadadienu.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Netālu no Celtnieklīča parka reindžere Roza un Rabla komanda atklāj meteorītu. Kad Ātrmeistars un Megameistars mēģina to piesavināties, ķepaiņi izmanto savus milzīgos braucamos, lai izglābtu pilsētu un nogādātu meteorītu uz Zinātnes centru.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Lola raizējas, ka viņas izstāde nebūs gana iespaidīga. Kad pievienojas Tērauds, viss noiet greizi pavisam satriecošā veidā! Kad Tērauda suņa bumbiņa pazūd kanalizācijā, Bobijam jāstājas pretim bailēm no tumsas.

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims un Kaja sastrīdas un sāk meklēt jaunus labākos draugus. // Tims un Kaja sacenšas zvaigžņu medībās pa visu Rambltonu. // Kad Tija noguļ iespēju redzēt griezošo zvaigzni, Tims mēģina tādu uztaisīt pats.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rivera grib uzņemt krītošas zvaigznes foto, tāpēc kucēni ceļ observatoriju. Kucēni apmaldās uz dabas takas un rod veidu, kā nokļūt mājās.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: "Dullo vecāku" galvenais varonis ir desmit gadus vecs zēns Timijs, kurš dzīvo izdomātā pilsētā Dimsdeilā, un tur viņam neklājas viegli. Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. Bet viss mainās, kad viņam uzrodas divi laumiņu krustvecāki - Kosmo, viņa sieva Vanda un vēlāk - viņu dēls Pufs. Timijs apjauš, ka laumiņu krustvecāki noteiktās robežās spēj piepildīt visas viņa vēlēšanās. Tomēr Timijs vēl ir maziņš un reizēm ievēlas ko tādu, kas netīši noved pie nepatikšanām.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora ceļo pa lietusmežu, sacerot dziesmiņu tētim, lai kopā ar viņu nosvinētu Tēta un Doras dienu! Dora ir gatava Čurro fiestai, taču izrādās, ka visus našķus ir apēduši Pirātrukši. Dora dodas meklēt īpašu dārgumu lādi, kurā paslēpti zelta čurro.

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Krokodilkungs baidās, ka tiks spiests izvēlēties starp senu labāko draugu Bazziju un jaunu labāko draudzeni Deiziju. Deizijas un Krokodilkunga vienkāršā mājiņa kokā tiek sarežģīta, kad viņi cenšas to paplašināt draugu dēļ.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Slēpošanas laikā Barbapapas uzceļ milzīgu iglū. Barbabravo and Barbalibs sacenšas drosmīgumā. Barbagudrais rada putekļu sūkšanas robotu, kas lieliski spēlē futbolu. Barbabērni sarīko spēli pret robotiem.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais pārklāj māju ar burvju produktu, lai novērstu ūdens sūci. Nākamajā dienā māja saplok kā balons. Putns uzvij ligzdu uz Barbazū vēdera. Barbazū grib kļūt par lieu koku, lai sniegtu patvērumu dzīvniekiem. Situācija kļūst sarežģīta.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs un Tija atrod pazudušu rotaļlietu un sola atgriezt to saimniekam. Kaja gaida, kad brauks ar Nebulatoru, bet Tims nav drošs. Tims un Kaja cenšas nofotografēt maldinošu Kosmosa vaboli.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims un Tija būvē laika mašīnu, lai nebūtu jāatklāj tētim patiesība. Tims dodas uz Dinostāra treniņu akadēmiju, bet ir neizpratnē par sava varoņa metodēm. Tēvocis Tibērijs apciemo Reksus, un Timam jāparāda, ka viņš māk uzvesties.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Jauni piedzīvojumi ar DORU! Pievienojies drošajai pasaules pētītājai Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu kopīgajos ceļojumos pa maģisko lietusmežu, kurā var notikt - un notiek - brīnumu lietas. Let's go!

Timijs apjauš, ka laumiņu krustvecāki noteiktās robežās spēj piepildīt visas viņa vēlēšanās. Tomēr Timijs vēl ir maziņš un reizēm ievēlas ko tādu, kas netīši noved pie nepatikšanām.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims cenšas būt divos pasākumos reizē. Tims meklē Kajai uzkodu bez purvzāles. Pēc vairākiem zaudējumiem Tija cenšas uzvarēt visās ballīšu spēlēs.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims atbrīvojas no vecajām lietām, bet drīz saprot, ka ne visam vieta miskastē.

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Ceļojumā uz Parīzi ģimene apskatīs lielisko Luvru. Diemžēl Barbalala neievēro strikto noteikumu - muzejā neēst. // Barbalala strikti ievēro ačgārnās dienas tradīcijas, kas cēlušās no seniem laikiem. Brāļi un māsas pievienojas viņai ačgārnajā dienā.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Vērojot zvaignzes Barbatētis un Lolita pamana lidojošo šķivīti un steidz pamodināt visu ģimeni. Izrādās, ka ciemos atlidojuši draugi, kuriem līdzi ir lielkājains mazulis, kurš pēkšņi uzradās viņu planētā. Ģimene ar kosmosa kuģi dodas mazuļa planētas meklējumos. // Barbatētis cer, ka viņi drīz atradīs mazuļa planētu. Bet ne viss iet pēc plāna un viņi nolaižas uz ļoti dīvainas planētas. Kā viņi tiks prom un vai atradīs mazuļa planētu?

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Bērniem ir garlaicīgi, jo ārā līst lietus. Bet vecāki zina, ka vajag tikai nedaudz iztēles, lai varētu izklaidēties aŗī lietū. Bērniem iztēle ir lieliska, varbūt pat pārāk... // Barbagudrais radīja dekoderi, kurš spēj iztulkot dzīvnieku skaņas, bet dzīvnieki fermā un pagalmā neko interesantu nesaka. Barbazū lūdz iztulkot okeāna iemītnieku valodu.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Krokodilkungs pievienojas vingrošanas klubam, jo Deizijai tas patīk. Kad Džidži un Rolands vairs negrib dalīt koku, Krokodilkungs un Deizija palīdz viņiem atrast jaunas mājas.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Pēc tam, kad Ātrmeistars uzbūvējis nedrošu rotaļlaukumu, Rabla komandai jādomā radoši un jāuzbūvē jauns laukums no veciem materiāliem. Pilsētas Čili Kūkarū ir apdraudēts, kad sāk iebrukt Rātsnama jumts! Par laimi suņi zina, kā to salabot.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad ceļojošā veterinārārste daktere Diva nevar laikā veikt visu Celtnieklīcī dzīvojošo dzīvnieku apskati, Rabla komanda zina, kā jārīkojas. Lilijas nāriņu ballīte tiek atsaukta, kad sāk līt. Laiks celtniecības risinājumam!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Pēc sniegota pārsteiguma pienākšanas, Rabla komanda piedāvā palīdzēt Hedlija viesnīcā. Kad kāpnes izrādās nepietiekami ātras, ir laiks celt. Karls adoptē kaķēnus. Kad viņi izraisa popkorna elli, Rabla komanda padara kafejnīcu kaķēniem draudzīgu.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora un Zābaciņš atrod apburošu aksolotla mazuli. Viņi dodas ceļā, lai nogādātu mazo nerātni mājās. Lielais Sarkanais Cālis iekļūst milzīgā burbulī, kurš viņu nes taisnā ceļā uz vulkānu! Lai viņu glābtu, arī Dorai nākas pacelties gaisā.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Isa rīko ballīti, kurā visi dejos Mūžameža ritmu. Ceļā uz svētkiem Zābaciņam jāpagūst iemācīties dejas soļus! Dora ar draugiem dodas uz Likstu un Lamatu Mežu, lai atrastu Tiko burvju riekstu, kurš spēj pārvērsties par ikviena mīļāko našķi.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabērni sagatavo izrādi Barbamammai dzimšanas dienā. Kamēr Barbalala uzkopj, viņi sodas uz lunaparku, kur Barbabo iesprūst karuselī. Trīs atsevišķi stāsti saplūst kopā pagalma vidū.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbaliba, Barbalala un Barbabella pēc kārtas stāsta stāstu. Katra iekļauj tajā ko ļoti personīgu. Barbapapu ģimene pavada dienu pludmalē. Sadalījušies 2 komandās, barbabērni cīnās par smilšu pussalu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: No kalna izbēdzis āzis izraisa haosu, aprīdams visu, kas pagadās! Bali nekur nav atrodama, un Barbapapa liek lietā savu attapību, meklējot viņu. Viņi pat nenojauš, kāds pārsteigums viņus gaida.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais izturas dīvaini. Ko viņš slēpj? Barbabērni darīs visu, lai to uzzinātu. Barbapapas izlemj taupīt elektrību, taču viņu ieceri izjauc Barbagudrais un Barbabella, kas izgudrojuši slepenu elektrību patērējošu projektu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabērni pielipuši pie televizora, tāpēc vecāki mudina viņus veidot raidījumus. Barbapapas apmeklē evolūcijas muzeju. Programmā: Zemes radīšana, Pirmskembrija perioda zemūdene un... dinozauri!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad Megameistars izaicina mēru Greitveju piedalīties triku sacensībās, Rabla komanda būvē satriecošas triku rampas. Kad elektrības traucējumi apdraud Sjerras Spīdošās koncertu, ķepaiņi izmanto lielos braucamos, lai atgrieztu elektrību.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad auto vadītājai Kamilai vajag vietu, kur paēst, kucēniem un Karlam rodas eleganta ideja. Bet vai tā nav pārāk eleganta? // Reindžere Roza un kaza Rozija gatavojas koncertam! Taču, kad Rozija pazūd, vai kucēniem izdosies viņu atrast?
